editorial:
Imagine being the best shot in the world, only to have the government frame you for a murder you didn't commit. That is exactly what happens to Brandon Beckett. You get to watch him go from a trusted Special Ops soldier to a fugitive in a heartbeat. The only person he can turn to is his dad, Thomas, who is also a legendary sniper. The vibe here is all about father-son bonding mixed with high-stakes hide-and-seek. It feels like a classic action flick where the heroes are outnumbered but have the best gear and the sharpest eyes in the room.

You will love the tension when the Becketts face off against a scary Yakuza assassin who is just as good with a rifle as they are. The action is steady, and while the plot is pretty simple, it keeps you moving. Some parts feel a bit slow, but the gunfights make up for it.
endingExplained: In the final showdown, Brandon and Thomas use their combined skills to outsmart the corrupt government agents and the Yakuza killer. After a tense sniper battle, they take down the bad guys and clear their names. The twist reveals exactly who was pulling the strings from inside the government to start a war. Once the truth comes out, the Becketts finally get some peace and can stop running for their lives.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves military shooters and father-son team-ups.
